note: Draft-order eligibility rules confirmed by the commissioner on 2026-10-20, plus the top-of-draft history they are computed from. Eligibility is derived by scripts/lottery_eligibility.py. The ball allocation is recorded under 'lottery'. Updated 2026-11-12: the 2027 bonus covers ranks 2, 3 and 4.

noTop2TwiceInARow.text: A team that picked 1st or 2nd in a draft cannot pick 1st or 2nd in the next draft.

oneNumberOnePerWindow.text: A team may make only one number-one pick in any 3-year span of drafts.

rules.source: Commissioner confirmation relayed by the league owner, 2026-10-20.

history.source: League owner, 2026-10-20: 'I picked 1st last year'; owner's team is Yahoo team 16 = sup fam. The 2025 second pick is not recorded here (not needed for any current eligibility).
data/2026-27/draft_state.json: 1.01 Cameron Boozer (Maxfixe), 1.02 AJ Dybantsa (Long con).

decisions.text: Eligibility belongs to the team that holds the slot when the lottery is drawn. First-round picks are only traded after keepers, which come after the lottery, so draft order is already final by then: a later trade of a top-2 pick does not move the restriction. History entries therefore name the team that held 1.01 / 1.02 at the lottery.
If the lottery draw lands a slot on an ineligible team, that slot is redrawn (for maximum suspense).

lottery.source: docs/LEAGUE_RULES_MODEL.md (rule document, 2026-27 model); owner, 2026-10-20: the ball allocation is the same for next season (2027 draft): a few playoff teams get balls and the 3rd and 4th place teams get a bonus, as the rule document indicates. Rule change confirmed by the commissioner and relayed by the league owner, 2026-11-12: for 2027 the bonus extends to the 2nd place team, so 2nd, 3rd and 4th get the pick 9-10-11 bonus subject to the lottery results, as last year.
lottery.drawNote: Pick 1.02 is resolved first, then 1.01. The prior winner remains eligible for 1.01; if the same team wins both, it keeps its choice of pick and the other pick is redrawn.
lottery.rank3And4Bonus: From the 2027 draft, regular-season ranks 2, 3 and 4 do not enter the lottery (2026: ranks 3 and 4). After 1.01 and 1.02 resolve, rank 2 takes pick 9, rank 3 pick 10 and rank 4 pick 11, subject to the lottery results.
lottery.rounds2And3: plain inverse regular-season standings: no lottery, no rank 2/3/4 bonus
lottery.ineligibleResult: A draw that lands on a team ineligible under 'rules' is redrawn (owner, 2026-10-20).

rank3And4.note: Key name kept for compatibility: it holds the bonus ranks of the draft being simulated (2027: ranks 2, 3 and 4).
rank3And4.interpretation: Reading used by the simulator (the pick numbers 9, 10 and 11 are the commissioner's; the order within them is our reading): after 1.01 and 1.02 resolve, rank 2 takes pick 9, rank 3 pick 10 and rank 4 pick 11; the other teams keep reverse-standings order around them.
